summary: Frontend-only regression for admin Live City Feed enhancements: (1) clickable player names in feed → quick-jump to Player Management with pre-filled search + auto-opened Edit modal, (2) DANGER severity events render with danger-pulse styling / DANGER pill / AlertTriangle icon, (3) player search filtering + X/Y count + clear button, (4) filter chips + LIVE auto-refresh. All flows PASSED on the deployed preview URL.
verified_flows: Login as admin@kaeldor.com/admin123 succeeds via ENTER KAELDOR button
/admin loads Overview group by default; Live Feed sub-tab (data-testid='admin-tab-live feed') switches to feed view with LIVE indicator visible
Feed renders 50 events; each has data-testid feed-event-<id> + data-severity attribute; player names rendered as feed-player-<playerId> clickable buttons

DANGER: 1 event on 'All' filter (Neo — 'collapsed from poor health and were rushed to hospital') has data-severity='danger', .danger-pulse class, red-tinted styling, AlertTriangle icon, and DANGER pill (feed-danger-<id>). All 49 non-danger events do NOT carry the danger-pulse class
Crime & Legal filter (feed-filter-crime) shows 44 events including 10 danger events (health/crime severity=danger) — pulse applied consistently

Quick-jump: clicking feed-player-<id> for 'Lucifer Cerberus' switches to Player Management, pre-fills player-search with 'Lucifer Cerberus' (input value verified), and auto-opens player-edit-modal showing editable Cash/Bank/Debt/Reputation/Legal Standing/Criminal Suspicion/Social Status/Health/Energy fields
Player search: typing 'Neo' changes X/Y count from 61/61 → 11/61; player-search-clear button clears input back to empty and restores full list
Save Player: edited a player's reputation (50 → 51) via save-player button — modal closed on save (persist confirmed via modal auto-dismiss); reverted change back to 50 to leave data unchanged
Auto-refresh: /admin/feed request observed firing within 8s window while LIVE indicator visible (matches ~6s cadence)
Filter chips all/purchases/work/crime/finance/social all present and clickable
No console errors during any of the flows
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is a large file (>1000 lines). Consider splitting LiveCityFeed and PlayersTable into their own modules for maintainability, though this is not blocking.

The 'Neo' search returning 11/61 hits suggests search matches substrings beyond just name (potentially character name / surname / etc.). Not a bug per spec, but worth confirming intended search fields.
seed_data_creation: None. Edited one player's reputation +1 during save-player verification and reverted immediately.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sub-tab testids use lowercased labels with spaces (e.g., 'admin-tab-live feed'). Danger event may drift down the feed as new events are generated; use feed-filter-crime to surface health/crime danger events reliably. Login button text is 'ENTER KAELDOR' (not 'Log In'). Player edit modal uses fixed inset overlay — Escape does not close it, click the X button (top-right in modal) or save/cancel via footer instead when scripting further tests.
